biographical_milestones.historical_context: Co-founded Apple in Cupertino garage with Steve Wozniak.

biographical_milestones.event: Ousted from Apple by Board of Directors
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Stripped of operational duties and resigned to found NeXT.

biographical_milestones.event: Triumphant Return to Apple as Interim CEO
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Reappointed CEO following Apple's acquisition of NeXT.
Passed away at Palo Alto home following prolonged health battle.
